identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-07] Move Terraform CI deployment and runbook authority

values.task_boundary: Implement only CORP-07 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Proven deployment and rollback runbooks executable by an authorized company operator.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform state, locks, plans, applies, and recovery operate under company custody.
CI uses company-controlled OIDC or equivalent short-lived identity and least privilege.
A clean deployment and rollback complete without founder-local credentials or unrecorded manual steps.
Runbooks name prerequisites, single commands, expected outputs, rollback, cleanup, and escalation without exposing secrets.
non_goals: Embedding credentials in workflows or runbooks
Replacing proven infrastructure during authority migration
Treating an unexecuted plan as deployment proof
